en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a posed group of people in traditional dress in front of thatched buildings. A row of young women stand in the back wearing patterned wrap skirts, beaded tops, and headscarves. In the foreground sits a masked figure dressed in raffia, and another seated person in patterned robes appears next to a wooden xylophone-like instrument. A young girl stands to the right wrapped in cloth. The right margin contains printed caption text and publisher information.
